description: Measured cellular energy budgets of prokaryotes and eukaryotes fall orders of magnitude short of the power needed to keep protein conformation and location classical at the angstrom and femtosecond scales that single-molecule decoherence calculations predict.

sources.quote: Measured cellular energy budgets of both prokaryotes and eukaryotes, however, fall orders of magnitude short of the power required to maintain classical states of protein conformation
